title: Welcome and Table of Contents
summary: An introduction to SS3 English Language First Term and the list of all units, covering vocabulary, spoken English, grammar, writing, comprehension, summary and listening.

p: Welcome to the final year of Senior Secondary English. A strong command of English is the key to precise expression and to doing well in every part of your examination: comprehension, summary, essay writing, oral English and grammar. This term you build vocabulary about culture and about motor vehicles, practise intonation, consonant clusters and the schwa, revise nouns and pronouns, learn to write an expository essay, and sharpen your reading, summary and listening skills.

Work through the units in order. Read the examples aloud, do the activities and practise the check questions at the end of each unit. The check questions do not count towards a mark, but they show you what you have understood.

sections.h: Table of contents for First Term
